asset_manifests.name: Site Marking Flagging Tape
asset_manifests.visual_identity: A roll of high-visibility, non-adhesive industrial orange flagging tape; features a semi-matte, durable plastic texture with 'DINO RESEARCH' printed in bold black typography; shown partially unrolled to reveal its flexible, ribbon-like quality; the edges of the roll show subtle 'field wear' and dust.
asset_manifests.notes: Essential for marking find-spots during prospecting and creating boundary lines around the excavation pit. The orange matches the project's consistent industrial tool palette.
